executor: Existing pg client submits only the two pinned repository SQL batches; no new runtime installer or workflow

target.endpointRule: Existing control URL only; verified TLS to .neon.tech; no Aurora/local database or alternate config fallback
target.bindingRule: Before DDL, exact database/session user, absent target names and complete saved old catalog must match; never substitute a historical endpoint or arbitrary URL

artifacts.normalization: UTF-8; CRLF converted to LF; no other substitution
UTF-8; CRLF converted to LF; no other substitution

objects.implicitObjects: Only constraints, indexes and internal foreign-key triggers generated by the two exact SQL batches inside deployment_release

catalogVerification.oldObjects: Compare every saved old schema/role-membership/relation/function/trigger/RLS/default-ACL/database-ACL entry by its original identity and definition/ACL summary; reject any missing or modified old entry
catalogVerification.allowedAdditionsAfterSchema: Only deployment_release_owner and its installer memberships, the exact new schema/three tables/nine functions, their SQL-generated internal objects and owner default ACL
catalogVerification.allowedAdditionsAfterGrants: Also allow only the exact planner/executor/verifier NOLOGIN roles, their implicit creator memberships and the exact scoped function/schema grants
catalogVerification.unexpectedObjectsOrMemberships: Stop; never discard changed old entries, ignore a whole name prefix or replace the saved baseline
catalogVerification.functionDefinitions: Match each exact signature, owner, SECURITY DEFINER, fixed search_path and server-side prosrc SHA256 against the corresponding approved SQL function body; source body never printed

runtimePrivileges.installerOwnerMembership: Temporarily SET=true, INHERIT=false inside each transaction; SET=false on completion; original creator ADMIN may remain

steps: Validate approval SHA, pinned SQL bytes, exact CI evidence and unchanged disabled runtime locally; create the one-time attempt record without replacing an old record
Read the fixed config once and connect via verified TLS; use a READ ONLY preflight to match database, actual installer, all seven absent proposed role names, absent schema and exact old catalog
Submit schema.draft.sql once without an outer transaction or SQL modifications; it owns its BEGIN/COMMIT

Use an independent READ ONLY connection to verify dedicated owner, exactly three empty tables/nine functions, PUBLIC revocation, installer SET/INHERIT closed and unchanged old catalog; close this connection
Only after explicit successful schema COMMIT and independent verification, submit grants.draft.sql once; it owns its BEGIN/COMMIT

Use a second independent READ ONLY connection to verify all four NOLOGIN roles, exact original function ACL, no table DML/owner membership for runtime roles, empty new tables and unchanged old catalog
Save only safe statuses, object IDs, ACL summaries and hashes locally; preserve the original manifest, attempt and partial results; leave runtime disabled
stopRules: No approval, expired original facts, changed artifacts/config target, name collision, unknown capability or changed old catalog: no DDL
Lost SQL/COMMIT acknowledgement: preserve UNKNOWN, do not resubmit, do not infer rollback; stop further writes
Schema verification failure or uncertainty: do not submit grants
Second transaction failure can leave the first committed empty schema installed; no automatic down, cleanup, compensation or owner privilege expansion
Independent verification may only use the preapproved remaining connections/query/time budget; no new connection or write retry when exhausted
Any mismatch stops the installation without altering old roles, tables, protection, tasks or approvals
excluded: Secret, KMS, IAM, OIDC or GitHub setting changes
ALB, ECS, RDS, Cell, network or DNS start/create/update/delete
Old schema/role/trigger/fence mutations or business-row reads
Instance/release seeding, business task creation or workflow dispatch
Enabling ops/releases/runtime.json, image publication, database migration or automatic cleanup
risks: Installer credentials are broad and the entire existing config file enters process memory; verified TLS does not eliminate network/provider-log or process-memory risks
Catalog DDL/role changes can briefly lock system catalogs and provider role-management hooks may reject installation; isolated PostgreSQL 16 CI is not Neon 18 installation proof
Two committed transactions and cross-connection observations are not atomic as a whole; concurrent old-catalog changes or partial installation can require later separately approved inspection
Creator ADMIN authority is retained; closing SET/INHERIT does not remove the installer administrator's ability to grant future access
Unknown submissions are not retried; committed objects are not automatically removed, reset or down-migrated
No new AWS billable resource is requested, but existing AWS storage and other resources can still incur fees and Neon usage may apply
